basic_details.short_information: Tata Institute of Social Sciences (TISS) is recruiting for the post of Consultant – Secretary (VC Office). The appointment is on a contract basis initially for a period of one year and extendable based on performance and requirement. Eligible candidates must possess a Master’s Degree in any discipline with a minimum of 55% marks, Shorthand Speed 80 wpm in English, and 10 years secretarial experience. The pay is a fixed monthly amount arrived at by deducting the basic pension from the pay drawn at the time of retirement. Applicants must apply online through the link provided on the Institute's

how_to_apply: Visit the Institute's website at www.tiss.edu and access the online application link provided along with the advertisement.
Fill out the Online Application Form and ensure you provide your Gmail ID.
Pay the applicable application fee online.
Submit the online application on or before 30 October 2026.
Take a print of the acknowledgement of the online application and keep it for future reference.
important_instructions: The Institute reserves the right to not fill up the vacancy advertised or invite persons for personal interaction who may not have applied. The Institute reserves the right to relax qualifications based on work experience. The post is unreserved, but candidates belonging to reserved categories are encouraged to apply. Canvassing in any form is strictly prohibited and will lead to debarment. No TA/DA is payable for appearing for the Personal Interaction if held at the Institute’s premises. Shortlisted candidates are required to send scanned copies of their coloured passport-size photograph and self-attested photocopies of relevant certificates. The selected candidate must join within 15 days of selection.

content_sections.heading: TISS Consultant – Secretary (VC Office) at a Glance

rows.details: Fixed monthly amount arrived at by deducting basic pension from pay drawn at retirement

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates must meet the educational qualification, shorthand speed, and work experience requirements stipulated for the post. Master’s Degree in any discipline with minimum 55% of aggregate marks from a recognized University / Institution. Shorthand Speed with minimum 80 words per minute in English. Minimum of 10 years of secretarial work experience of which at least 5 years of experience of Office / Secretariat Management for the officer of the Pay Level 12 (as per 7 CPC) or more. Excellent drafting and communication skills. Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities. Ability to work independently while maintaining confidentiality. Retired Govt. employees having the secretarial work experience may be preferred.

content_sections.heading: Age Limit
content_sections.text: Candidates must be below 65 years of age.

content_sections.heading: Remuneration
content_sections.text: A fixed monthly amount shall be admissible, arrived at by deducting the basic pension from the pay drawn at the time of retirement.

content_sections.heading: TISS Consultant – Secretary (VC Office) Job Description
content_sections.text: The selected candidate will be responsible for the following duties and functions in the office: Executive and Secretarial Support Meeting Coordination Correspondence Management Office Administration Liaison and Coordination Confidentiality and Compliance Record Keeping and Reporting Use of Technology to manage office Systems

content_sections.heading: Application Fee
content_sections.text: The application fee must be paid online. Fees once paid shall not be refunded under any circumstances. The application will be valid only on receipt of the application fee, if applicable.

rows.fee: Nil (Waived from payment of application fees)

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Applications received will be shortlisted by the Institute. Shortlisted candidates will be informed over e-mail to appear for a Personal Interaction to be conducted at TISS, Mumbai. Requests for online personal interaction will not be entertained. Merely possessing the prescribed minimum qualifications and requisite experience does not entitle a person to be called for personal interaction.

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: The Institute reserves the right to not fill up the vacancy advertised or invite persons for personal interaction who may not have applied. The Institute reserves the right to relax qualifications based on work experience. The post is unreserved, but candidates belonging to reserved categories are encouraged to apply. Canvassing in any form is strictly prohibited and will lead to debarment. No TA/DA is payable for appearing for the Personal Interaction if held at the Institute’s premises. Shortlisted candidates are required to send scanned copies of their coloured passport-size photograph and self-attested photocopies of relevant certificates. The selected candidate must join within 15 days of selection.

faq.question: Q1. What is the post being recruited for at TISS?
faq.answer: TISS is recruiting for the post of Consultant – Secretary (VC Office) on a contract basis.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available?
faq.answer: The exact number of vacancies is not specified in the notification.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply online?
faq.answer: The last date of receipt of online application is 30 October 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the essential educational qualification required?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Master’s Degree in any discipline with a minimum of 55% aggregate marks from a recognized University or Institution, alongside a shorthand speed of minimum 80 words per minute in English.

faq.question: Q5. What is the required work experience?
faq.answer: Candidates need a minimum of 10 years of secretarial work experience, with at least 5 years of experience in office or secretariat management for an officer of Pay Level 12 (as per 7 CPC) or more.

faq.question: Q6. What is the age limit for this position?
faq.answer: The age limit for applicants is below 65 years.

faq.question: Q7. How is the remuneration calculated?
faq.answer: A fixed monthly amount is admissible, arrived at by deducting the basic pension from the pay drawn at the time of retirement.

faq.question: Q8. Is there any application fee?
faq.answer: Yes, the application fee is Rs. 500/- for general candidates, Rs. 125/- for SC/ST/PWD candidates with certificates, while women applicants are waived from fee payment.

faq.question: Q9. Can retired government employees apply?
faq.answer: Yes, retired Central Government servants are invited to apply as Consultant – Secretary, and retired government employees having secretarial work experience may be preferred.

faq.question: Q10. How will candidates be selected?
faq.answer: Candidates will be shortlisted based on applications and called for an offline Personal Interaction to be conducted at TISS, Mumbai.
